### MongoDB counts, distinct, cursors and read-path tuning

- **MongoDB counts, distinct, cursors and read-path tuning** · self

### count

- **count** · part — Counts the number of documents remaining in a cursor. · aka: countDocuments, estimatedDocumentCount, count(), db.collection.count, $count, COUNT_SCAN, count operations, db.collection.distinct, distinct(), DISTINCT_SCAN, $sample, random sample, pseudo-random cursor — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.itcount.md#definition

### cursor

- **cursor** · part — `cursor.explain()` defaults to `queryPlanner`, unlike the [`explain`](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/explain.md#mongodb-dbcommand-dbcmd.explain) command, which defaults to `allPlansExecution`. · aka: batchSize, batch size, cursor.batchSize, getMore, firstBatch, maxTimeMS, cursor.maxTimeMS, noCursorTimeout, cursor timeout, cursorTimeoutMillis, tailable cursor, maxAwaitTimeMS, exhaust cursor — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.explain.md#definition

### query shape

### index

- **index** · related — If the above conditions are not met, MongoDB cannot use the wildcard index for the sort. MongoDB does not support [`sort()`](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.sort.md#mongodb-method-cursor.sort) operations that require a different index from that of the query predicate. · aka: indexes, indexed, IXSCAN, COLLSCAN, collection scan, explain, executionStats, winningPlan — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-wildcard/reference/restrictions.md#queries-with-sort
